findings.title: BULK_RATE is a float, so every bulk-discounted cart crashes
findings.explanation: amount is a Decimal; Decimal * 0.05 raises TypeError, so total() fails for any cart that qualifies for the bulk discount. Use BULK_RATE = Decimal("0.05").

findings.title: Bulk threshold excludes exactly 10 units
findings.explanation: README rule 3 grants the discount at 10 or more units, but quantity() > BULK_MIN_QTY only applies from 11. Use >=.

findings.title: Coupon percent is not validated
findings.explanation: README rule 4 requires a ValueError when a coupon is created with a percent outside 1..100 (or not a whole number). Coupon has no __post_init__ check, so Coupon('X', 150) is accepted and produces a negative total.

findings.title: Mutable default list shares coupons across carts
findings.explanation: coupons=[] is evaluated once and stored by reference; add_coupon on one Cart() appends to the list shared by every other Cart created without coupons, so one customer's coupon discounts other carts. Use None and copy: self.coupons = list(coupons or []).
